gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-savate: Commanding and a bit vintage, Woodgod lets its tall lowercase crowd up against the capitals. And Savate, a plain sans, goes lighter, with finer crossbars and curves that stay open.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-schibsted-grotesk: Approachable is the first word for Schibsted Grotesk, though Woodgod above it is the louder voice, vintage and display-bold. Schibsted Grotesk keeps paragraphs inviting, its tall-bowled a and e leaving terminals open all the way down.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-sen: Sen reads modern and tall, each letter traced in a constant line, with curves that stop before turning inward. Woodgod's wide-channeled bowls make the sturdier partner.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-sintony: Sintony reads smooth and clean, its chunky, tall midzone leaving no curve clogged. But under Woodgod's commanding, vintage display letters, a long passage would feel steady and easy to follow.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-sofia-sans: Sofia Sans brings rounded, modern letters with no thick and thin at all, standing tall like cut acrylic stencil pieces. Sofia Sans runs almost like neon tubing beside Woodgod, whose heading is commanding and vintage.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-sono: Woodgod leads with a commanding, vintage voice, its wide channel into every bowl and lowercase nearly as tall as the capitals. Sono follows with widely spaced letters and ajar a shapes, so a long passage feels approachable.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-stack-sans-notch: Woodgod opens with commanding, vintage display letters, its tall lowercase nearly matching the capitals in height. Stack Sans Notch follows in signage-like sans-serif lines, so a long passage reads clean and big-bodied.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-stack-sans-text: Stack Sans Text reads modern, drawn with a marker-like line and big-bodied lowercase whose curve endings stay well apart. Woodgod does the commanding, vintage showpiece work; the sans handles the quieter everyday lines.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-sulphur-point: Sulphur Point reads plain and bulky, with marker-like lines and clear gaps in its curves. Woodgod brings commanding, vintage display weight on top, and the sans keeps its constant-width lines underneath without competing.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-tiktok-sans: TikTok Sans reads modern, with a lowercase rising near cap height. Woodgod above it has a commanding, vintage voice and tall lowercase of its own, so both fonts share that height while the sans opens its c wide.
